title: Mini RLHF feedback loop API sketch
body:
Context: quick, personal sketch for a very small feedback ingestion API that product teams (hosted + private deploy) can opt into for collecting user signals to drive lightweight reward models / ranking. Purpose is NOT a full-labeling pipeline — this is a low-friction carrier for: scalar ratings, forced-choice ranking, short commentary, and sparse annotation tokens.

Goals / constraints:
- Minimal client integration (one POST endpoint, small payload).
- Privacy-first: opt-in per-tenant + per-user, PII minimization by default.
- Works in hosted + Dedicated + Private (local agent bridges).
- Sampled ingestion to control cost and annotation budget.
- Idempotent, append-only event store semantics.
- Lightweight SDK hooks to patch into frontend / SDKs (JS/Android/iOS).

Open questions (to resolve):
- retention policy defaults for hosted vs private? (hosted default 90d, private configurable)
- should we allow free-text reference labels (could leak PII) -> provide redact flag and auto-scrub pipeline?
- encryption at rest / KMS: in private deploy agent should forward encrypted payloads, or avoid forwarding raw text?

Surface-level API shape (current thinking):
POST /v1/mini-feedback (ingest)
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <client_key>   # per-tenant API key
  X-RLHF-Sampling-Version: v1         # optional header to indicate sampling rules in client
  Idempotency-Key: <uuid>             # optional, but recommended for client retries

Request JSON payload (compact):
{
  "tenant_id": "tn-12345",            # required (string)
  "user_id": "usr-...." ,            # optional (nullable) - can be hashed on client
  "user_id_hash": "sha256:abcd...",  # recommended instead of raw user id
  "session_id": "s-789",             # optional session correlation
  "context_id": "ctx-...",           # optional reference (conversation id, request id)
  "model": "gpt-4-like-v1",          # model that produced the output being rated
  "prompt_snapshot": "brief prompt summary or hash",  # optional - small
  "event_time": "2026-02-20T14:12:00Z",
  "signals": [                         # list of 1..N small signals
    {
      "type": "scalar_rating",      # scalar_rating | ranking_choice | pairwise | text_annotation | click",
      "key": "helpfulness",         # metric key
      "value": "4",                 # stringified to keep schema simple (we will coerce), or "4.0"
      "scale": "1-5",               # optional
      "weight": "1"                 # sampling weight metadata (string)
    }
  ],
  "annotations": [                     # optional free-text annotations (short)
    {
      "type": "short_feedback",
      "text": "answer was mostly right but missed step 3",
      "redact": "client_masked"       # values: client_masked | redacted_by_server | none
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {                       # freeform kv; small (max 8 entries, 256 bytes each)
    "sdk_version": "js-1.5.2",
    "route": "completion:chat:reply"
  }
}

Notes on fields/choices:
- user_id optional; prefer client-side hashing (user_id_hash). Keep raw PII out of hosted defaults.
- prompt_snapshot should be CHAR-LIMITED (<= 512 chars) or we accept a content-hash + prefix snippet.
- signals as list allows bundling several metrics in one call (e.g., rating + click).
- use small strings for numbers to avoid schema churn across clients. Server validates/normalizes.

Event types (short table):
- scalar_rating: single numeric rating
- ranking_choice: index chosen among provided options (client may provide options hash separately)
- pairwise: A vs B chosen; payload includes candidate_ids
- text_annotation: short free-text commentary (length limit)
- click: click-through / downstream action (to capture implicit feedback)

Security / privacy model (draft):
- Default hosted retention: 90d raw, 3yr aggregated. Private deploy: tenant config.
- Clients must indicate "consent: true" in metadata for user-generated content. If no consent, only accept non-text signals (scalar_rating, ranking_choice) and hashed ids.
- Server-side redaction pipeline: apply simple regex PIImask + LLM-based PII classifier (batch job) before storage for any free-text. Flagged content is truncated and replaced with "[REDACTED]" and a tokenized fingerprint returned for linking to labels if tenant allows.

Sampling / cost controls:
- Sampling rules configured per-tenant (console) e.g.: 5% uniform, 100% critical flows, cascade rules (e.g., high-confidence-false positives).
- Client-side sampling helpers provided in SDK (decide locally whether to send) to reduce token transfer. SDK should be able to query sampling policy with cached TTL (X-RLHF-Sampling-Version).
- Server enforces quota: sampled events billed per-ingest-unit. SDKs can attach budget tags to annotate budget buckets.

Ingestion semantics / ordering:
- Append-only event store. Event receives generated server_id.
- Idempotency-key used to dedupe idempotent retries. If duplicate within 7d, return existing event id.
- Partial validation: accept best-effort, return 2xx with warnings when redaction occurred; return 4xx for missing tenant or malformed core fields.
- Backpressure: 429 + Retry-After when tenant rate limit exceeded; 503 for transient server overload.

Return payload (success):
{
  "status": "accepted",
  "event_id": "ev_01G...",
  "ingested_at": "2026-02-20T14:12:01Z",
  "warnings": ["text_annotation redacted: pii_masked"]
}

Client SDK vibes (JS quick hooks):
- feedback.send({tenant_id, context_id, signals, annotations, consent}) -> returns promise
- feedback.batch(bufferSize=50, flushIntervalMs=2000) -> auto-batch
- feedback.querySamplingPolicy(tenant_id) -> returns sampling rules (ttl=60s)
- local hashing helper: feedback.hashUserId(uid) -> sha256-prefixed

Agent/Private deploy bridge pattern:
- Private deployments run agent that accepts the same POST shape on internal network and either persists locally or forwards encrypted blobs to hosted central when tenant config allows.
- Bridge must implement a scrub step configurable by tenant: client-side (recommended) or bridge-side redaction.

Downstream usage (storage & training flows):
- Raw events should be stored in a per-tenant bucket with lifecycle rules. A daily job builds teacher datasets (pairwise/ranking) and trains tiny reward models or produces ranking labels.
- Allow an export API: GET /v1/mini-feedback/export?tenant=tn-12345&since=...&format=delta or s3-uri. Access controlled.

Minimal schema for exports (CSV-friendly):
- event_id,event_time,tenant_id,user_hash,signal_type,signal_value,annotation_snippet,model,ctx_hash

Operational concerns:
- Sampling policy rollout safety: clients should be conservative (don’t switch from 100% -> 1% without prefetched sampling token).
- Debug mode: ephemeral endpoint to send full-text for debug with strict tenant consent and audit logs.
- Cost instrumentation: per-event ingest-charge metric + token-size estimate (for text annotations).

Backlog / TODOs:
- decide retention defaults + add per-region constraints (EU data residency)
- concrete redaction heuristics and build a tiny redaction microservice
- RBAC model for export API + tenant-managed token rotation
- Define a mini-UI in console for sampling rules and quick label inspection (text + aggregated histograms)
- Integration plan with existing labeling UI (product) for manual sample review

Quick examples (realistic payloads):
1) scalar rating + comment (anonymous user):
POST /v1/mini-feedback
{
  "tenant_id": "tn-acme",
  "user_id_hash": "sha256:10b3...",
  "context_id": "conv-2026-02-19-abc",
  "model": "redwood-chat-1.1",
  "event_time": "2026-02-19T17:05:12Z",
  "signals": [{"type":"scalar_rating","key":"helpfulness","value":"3","scale":"1-5" }],
  "annotations": [{"type":"short_feedback","text":"good overview but missed the last step","redact":"client_masked"}],
  "metadata": {"sdk_version":"js-1.6.0"}
}

2) pairwise ranking (A vs B):
{
  "tenant_id":"tn-acme",
  "signals":[{"type":"pairwise","key":"prefer","value":"A","candidate_ids":"candA,candB"}],
  "event_time":"2026-02-20T09:01:02Z"
}

Notes to self: keep this spec minimal. Focus on optics: easy SDK + single endpoint. Let labeling pipeline + export handle heavy lifting. Tie sampling policy to Console so product can iterate without SDK releases.

End of sketch.

(If I revisit: add sequence diagrams, a small Mermaid-ish flow, and wire up with 'feedback-proto' repo PR.)
